text:
Marta R: heads up — we have a cross-cloud + HW partner + SI launch we want to align for the next QBR. need a playbook and MDF split by EOD Friday. who can own the ops doc? :calendar:
Ajay S: I can lead scorecards. quick question — what metric do we gate partner tier MDF on? revenue closed, pipeline, or marketplace activations?
Kevin L: product note: SI connector v2 tests are green but there's a 2wk stagger on edge-compat modules. we can do marketplace listing + docs first, then enable connector flag.
Lina T: i'll own GTM assets. need partner logos, co-brand guidances, and a one-pager. timeline request: asset freeze 10 business days before announcement.
Sam H: partner ops: HW partner confirmed up to $100k MDF but prefers milestone-based drawdown (invoice on activation + 30d). they want a 3-month co-fund runway.
Marta R: rough MDF suggestion: 60% partner-funded demand gen, 30% joint events/PR, 10% channel enablement. e.g.
```text
MDF total: $100,000
- Demand gen: $60,000
- PR/events: $30,000
- Enablement: $10,000
``` 
Ajay S: for scorecards, propose gating on: 1) marketplace listings live, 2) >50 activations in 30d, 3) pipeline > $250k attributable. if a partner misses 2/3, reduce next quarter MDF by 50%.
Kevin L: risk: if connector delay hits, suggested soft-launch flow:
- marketplace listing & docs (T0)
- enable limited SI pilot (T0+2w)
- full connector enable (T0+4w)
That keeps momentum while we finish edge modules.
Lina T: draft launch timeline:
- Asset freeze: 2026-04-17
- Marketplace listing live: 2026-04-24
- Joint webinar: 2026-05-05
- QBR readout: 2026-05-12
Marta R: action items:
- @Ajay S: create partner scorecard template (due 2026-04-14)
- @Lina T: collect partner logos + co-brand (due 2026-04-10)
- @Kevin L: confirm feature-flag plan and fallback (due 2026-04-12)
- @Sam H: confirm MDF payment cadence & signed SOW (due 2026-04-09)
Ajay S: noted — i'll add scoring columns and sample calculations. also suggest adding a marketplace activation macro in console for easier attribution.
Sam H: partner agrees to milestone invoices + one consolidated SOW. i'll circulate SOW draft today.
announce-bot: calendar event created: "QBR: HW partner launch pre-brief" on 2026-04-15 10:00 PT. Invitees: Marta R, Ajay S, Kevin L, Lina T, Sam H.
Marta R: thanks everyone. i'll compile the playbook draft after items land and share a single doc for review. :thumbsup:
